test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

A group of Googlers get together regularly to ______ and decide which events will be celebrated with a doodle.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Brainstorm'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brainstorming** is a process in which a group or an individual comes up with ideas for a specific purpose.
 
• **It fits perfectly** in this context as it suggests that Googlers (employees of Google) gather to think creatively and decide which events will be celebrated with a doodle.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: A group of Googlers get together regularly to **brainstorm** and decide which events will be celebrated with a doodle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine the other options:

 
 
• **"Discredit": **This means to harm the good reputation of someone or something. It does not fit the context as Googlers are not gathering to harm the reputation of anything.
 
• **"Relief": **In this context, this noun would mean a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following the removal of stress or discomfort. It doesn't make sense as a verb describing what the group of Googlers are doing.
 
• **"Salute": **This typically means to show respect to someone or something, often through a formal sign such as a raised hand or a bow. While Google Doodles often do honor individuals or events, the act of deciding which ones to honor would be more accurately described as brainstorming than saluting.
